title: VS Solution personal workspace settings
description: Personal settings of the VS Solution extension for this workspace folder. Not meant to be committed.

solution.description: Selected solution, relative to the workspace folder. Written by the panel.

configuration.description: Selected solution configuration as "Configuration|Platform". Written by the panel.

startupProject.description: Startup project name as written in the .sln. Written by the panel.

toolchain.description: Visual Studio and MSBuild location. Found through vswhere when omitted.

vsVersion.description: vswhere version range such as "[16,17)", or "latest" (default).

msbuildPath.description: Explicit MSBuild.exe path. Normally not needed.

environment.description: Environment variables applied to build, IntelliSense and debug. Part of the IntelliSense cache key.

saveBeforeBuild.description: Save dirty editors before a build.

buildBeforeDebug.description: Build the project before starting it.

maxParallelism.description: Number of simultaneous MSBuild processes for IntelliSense; 0 means CPU cores / 2.

projects.description: Per-project overrides, keyed by project name. Anything not set comes from MSBuild.

byConfiguration.description: Overrides for one solution configuration, keyed by "Configuration|Platform".

program.description: Program to start. Default: LocalDebuggerCommand, then TargetPath.

cwd.description: Working directory. Default: LocalDebuggerWorkingDirectory, then the project directory.
